description: Retrieves all check items from a Trello checklist. Returns item details including name, position, completion state, and optionally due dates and assigned members.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving check items from a specific Trello checklist.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each check item, or 'all' for all fields. Available fields: name, nameData, pos, state, type, due, dueReminder, idMember.
fields.title: Fields

filter.description: Filter which check items to return. 'all' returns all items, 'none' returns no items.
filter.title: Filter

idChecklist.description: The unique identifier (24-character hex string) of the Trello checklist to retrieve items from.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

inputSchema.title: GetChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistRequest

name: get_checklists_check_items_by_id_checklist

CheckItem.description: A single check item within a Trello checklist.

creationMethod.description: Method used to create the check item, if tracked.
creationMethod.title: Creation Method

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format, if set.
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Due reminder setting in minutes before due date, if set.
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: The unique identifier for the check item (24-character hex string).
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: The ID of the parent checklist containing this check item.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: ID of the member assigned to this check item, if any.
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: The name/text of the check item.
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional data about the name, including emoji information.
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: The position of the item within the checklist (numeric value).
pos.title: Pos

state.description: The completion status of the item: 'complete' or 'incomplete'.
state.title: State

CheckItem.title: CheckItem

GetChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistResp.description: Response schema containing a list of check items from the specified Trello checklist.

check_items.description: List of check items from the checklist. May be empty if no items exist or filter='none'.
check_items.title: Check Items

GetChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistResp.title: GetChecklistsCheckItemsByIdChecklistResponse
